content.text:
The grey descriptive text on the home page is now `#3d4650`, and the other pages are unchanged.

I added a rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css` that sets `--color-muted: #3d4650` for `.page-home main`. I checked the computed colours in the browser. The hero subtitle, the stat labels, the card descriptions, and the newsletter note and blurb all read `rgb(61, 70, 80)`, which is `#3d4650`.

I left the footer at its original grey, because it isn't text under a heading. Say so if you want it darkened too.

The functional tests pass (16), and so do the visual tests (12). The visual tests passed even though the home page text changed colour, so they are tolerant enough not to catch this change. The approved screenshots may need refreshing, but I didn't touch them.

STATUS: DONE
